timingMeaning: configured software limits, not measured real-time or optical safety guarantees
armMeaning: LED-only firmware test protocol; not exposed by Linux driver; requires healthy inputs, current boot/epoch, fresh heartbeat, local button edge, monotonic sequence
stopMeaning: any CRC-valid STOP revokes output and local arm regardless of old boot/epoch; malformed frames never authorize output
detachMeaning: epoch increments on dock state change; output, arm and heartbeat revoked; epoch overflow fails closed until reboot
identityMeaning: boot nonce and USB serial select/reset the bench session; neither is signed hardware identity or biometric authorization
billing: reuse existing RockstarOS owner contract; no new pricing or device base charge
